name: Setsugekka
message: 「Iori-sensei！」
With the Martial Festival over and the fierce battle between Setsugekka and Momiji having drawn to a close, a summer vacation that had regained its peace and quiet—
One such day, someone suddenly called out to me.
When I turned around, standing there.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka... and Keisetsu？ What brings you two here together？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I've come here today to make a request of you.」

name: Iori
message: 「A request？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「We've discussed it before, haven't we? The matter of becoming a personal trainer.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Someone to whip me into shape—bish-bash！」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, that again...」
Huffing eagerly and brimming with motivation, Setsugekka was practically leaning right in toward me.
However... reacting in the complete opposite way, I shrugged my shoulders and shook my head.

name: Iori
message: 「I'm pretty sure I already turned that down, didn't I？」

name: Iori
message: 「As a teacher, I'll guide Setsugekka as part of instructing Takamura Class. However, I have no intention of becoming her personal trainer.」
Keisetsu had sounded me out about this several times before.
She wanted me to become Setsugekka's personal trainer and devote my attention solely to her.
However, since doing that would mean I'd no longer be a teacher, I turned her down every time.
Even so, for the sake of her own ideals, Keisetsu wouldn't give up easily.
And Setsugekka, too—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Why not, Sensei~！」
With sheer momentum fiercer than anyone else's, Setsugekka pushed relentlessly toward me.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I want you to train me even harder, Sensei—bish-bash, bush-besh！」

name: Iori
message: 「I don't know what 'bush-besh' is, but... anyway. That's strictly something we'll do in class. As teacher and student.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Nooo way！ Please, Sensei！ I want to get even stronger！」
Saying that, Setsugekka closed in on me even more.
...Physically.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Momimomi is definitely going to get even stronger from here on out！ To stand up to her, I have to do way, way more special training and get stronger too！」

name: Iori
message: 「More importantly, you're too close...！ Your face and body are way too close！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That's because you won't become my trainer, Sensei！」

name: Iori
message: 「That isn't a reason at all！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I only have Sensei！ It has to be Sensei, or else no way！ I mean, I already love Sensei and I want us to go out！！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「……What？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「…………Wait, what？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Aaaaaaaaaah！？ D-d-d-did I just say something weird, or rather, I totally blurted it right out, didn't I！？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Hold on, Setsugekka…… What are you saying in the middle of all this confusion？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It's no-, not that, it's not！ Well, it's not *not* that, though！ It's just, I got the timing wrong, or rather, I let it slip on pure momentum！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It's just, that wasn't a lie or anything, it was like my true feelings accidentally popped out, that kind of thing！ So it *is* true！ Please believe me！」

name: Iori
message: 「N-no, that's not the point……」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I really, truly love Sensei, and I think things like wanting to go out, or wanting to be lovers, or even getting married instead, and then I get embarrassed and writhe around over it！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka, calm down a little. You're running completely wild.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But I don't want him to think what I just said was a lie just from momentum！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Whether it's a lie or not, you're saying it purely on momentum.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ha! Right! Once he knows my feelings are real, Sensei's answer is what matters!」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「How does it end up like that, I wonder.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What do you say, Sensei！ I want us to go out, so how does Sensei feel about itー！」

name: Iori
message: 「Eh！？ Ah, no, u-um……！」
Setsugekka was practically out of control at this point.
Caught off guard by such a massive topic thrown at me with that kind of momentum, I flinched before I could stop myself.
Still, I needed to stay calm here, so I spread my hands to soothe Setsugekka somehow.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, calm down first！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But I want to become Sensei's lover……！！」

name: Iori
message: 「I get how you feel, loud and clear！ It's okay, don't worry. Your sincerity came through, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Really！？ Then……！」

name: Iori
message: 「Still！ Something like this really matters. Precisely because I can tell your feelings are genuine, Setsugekka, I don't think I should give you a careless answer in the heat of the moment！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well... maybe... you're right...？」

name: Iori
message: 「So for now, let's put my answer on hold—could you wait just a little longer？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Understood！」

name: Iori
message: （Thank goodness, looks like she's convinced...）

name: Iori
message: 「And, uh... about the personal trainer thing, that's still out of the question, though」

name: Iori
message: 「Still, I could do private tutoring or special training over summer break, separate from your regular assignments」

name: Iori
message: 「Could you settle for that right now？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Pushing you any harder clearly won't get a yes, so let's call it a deal for today」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmph, very well. I shall let you off the hook for now」

name: Iori
message: 「Y-Yeah. I really appreciate it, you two」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Then we'll take our leave. Come along, Setsugekka」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh？ Just thinking I might stay here a little longer」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Because there's something I'd like to discuss with you in private. Just the two of us」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa, is this the scary kind of talk？ Am I getting a lecture！？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Hehe... Come along now, Setsugekka」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Gyaaah！ S-Sensei, save meee！」
Setsugekka was dragged off down the hall by Keisetsu.
I'm glad they gave up on the personal trainer idea. ...Still, that left me with something else on my mind.

name: Iori
message: 「...She really confessed to me, huh」
Left alone in the hallway, I thought back on it deeply.
To think Setsugekka had such strong feelings for me...
Honestly, it made me happy.
—After all, I liked Setsugekka so much that I'd wanted to say yes right then and there.
Ever since that day I played Pochemon with Setsugekka.
Little by little, her presence in my heart had grown bigger and bigger.
Always so energetic and reckless, the kind you can't take your eyes off of, yet finding even that cute.
Before I knew it, I realized I'd come to see Setsugekka as someone special.

name: Iori
message: 「...Though at the end of the day, I am still a teacher, after all」
There's the matter of my position, and I also want to treat everyone equally. That's why I've kept my feelings in check until now.
Even so, I ended up learning how Setsugekka feels.
Truth be told, I love Setsugekka too, and I want to answer her feelings right this second.

name: Iori
message: 「Still... now isn't the right time, is it.」
I found out that Setsugekka and I feel the same way. For now, I should be satisfied with that alone.
I have to desperately suppress this elation and maintain a resolute attitude as a teacher. Telling myself to endure it like that—
I scratched my head and headed toward the faculty room.
The next day, the request for private tutoring came right away. ...Though it wasn't directly from Setsugekka, but through Keisetsu.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「U-Umm...」
When the appointed time arrived, Setsugekka timidly peeked in.
Of course, I knew the reason why. Besides, I also felt... kind of awkward, and couldn't meet her eyes.

name: Iori
message: 「O-Oh, you're here. Well then, uh... shall we start the special training right away?」

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka？ What's wrong？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Umm, Sensei...！ Before we start the special training, may I ask you one thing...！」

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa...？ W-What is it？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I do want you to train me, but... there's something I just can't stop thinking about, and it's making me anxious...」

name: Iori
message: 「Anxious？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well... it's about yesterday！」

name: Iori
message: 「Urk... W-Well, of course it is... A lot happened.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Kei-chan got really mad at me too, saying I shouldn't have said it at a time like that...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, though for some reason she praised me in the end.」
So Keisetsu was supporting Setsugekka's feelings too, huh.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Anyway！ Yesterday, I spent the whole night writhing, screaming, and rolling around, so I somehow managed to live with that part.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But then instead... what you said started bothering me a little, Sensei...」

name: Iori
message: 「What I said？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Um... when you asked me to wait, could it be that you only said that so you could turn me down...！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If that's the case, please don't wait for the right moment or hope it'll just fizzle out—just tell me straight！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm already prepared...！ I even wrapped a towel around my pillow so it'll be fine if I soak it with tears！」

name: Iori
message: 「Is that really an effective countermeasure...？」
For some reason bracing herself pessimistically, Setsugekka clenches her teeth and starts waiting.
I'm a bit at a loss for how to answer that, though—

name: Iori
message: 「Since I'm the one who asked you to wait, I can't exactly say anything too weird here, but...」

name: Iori
message: 「Still, let's see...」

name: Iori
message: 「...Would it be okay if I told you that I'll definitely give you the answer you want？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh...？！ Wait, does that mean...」

name: Iori
message: 「I can't say any more than that right now. Could you let me off with just this for the time being？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「The answer I want... That means...！」

name: Iori
message: 「No, don't think any further than that！ Right now, you and I are strictly teacher and student, not lovers！ I need you to stop right there for now.」
When I hurriedly stop her, Setsugekka stares at my face for a moment...

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Understood！ I'll stop right here！ I'll stop right here and wait for you, Sensei！」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I'd be happy if you did.」
With a big smile, Setsugekka seemed convinced.
Seeing that makes me feel both relieved and happy.
And thanks to that, I'm able to steel my focus again.

name: Iori
message: 「...All right！ Let's get started on our special training then！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes！ Thank you for training me！」
Since this isn't a regular class, we breeze through some light basic conditioning and jump straight into practical combat training.
Setsugekka brought the theme herself, and it was 'controlling her berserk state.'
That said, I feel like she's already gotten pretty good at handling it, though—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Take this, dammit—！」

name: Iori
message: 「Not bad at all, Setsugekka！」
Along with a fierce battle cry, Setsugekka swings her Origami right and left in rapid succession.
I carefully parry each strike one by one, then step far back in anticipation of her follow-up attack.
Seeing that, Setsugekka halts the arm she was about to wind up, kicks hard off the ground, and closes the distance in an instant.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Like hell I'll let you get away, you bottom-feeder—！」
I slip sideways past the kick flying straight for my face and circle smoothly around to Setsugekka's flank.
Of course, Setsugekka immediately chases after me and whips out a backfist, which I dodge with a sway, elusively weaving out of the way as I speak.

name: Iori
message: 「'Bottom-feeder,' huh? Your repertoire of insults has grown！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Get caught already like a cheap thug！ If you do, I'll wreck you completely, utterly tear you apart！」

name: Iori
message: 「Hearing you say that makes me want to get caught even less！」
The moment I backed out of range of her fists, Setsugekka immediately switched from hand-to-hand martial arts to swordplay.
As if entangling me so I couldn't escape, she forced me to stay put and defend.
Then, the instant my movement stopped, she closed in right away and dragged me into a slugfest.

name: Iori
message: 「Still, you've got plenty of control over your rampage. The sloppiness that usually comes with going berserk looks like it's gone！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Not yet……！ I'm still not in control！ Besides, something I'm not in control of is happening――right now, right heeere！！」
Surprised by the onslaught growing fiercer by the second as she screamed, I kept dodging at the very last hair's breadth.
The momentum of her lunges and power of her steps are good as ever, and on top of that she's managing her spacing too. Blending martial arts and swordplay goes without saying.
Her words and behavior are still rough as usual, yet in reverse, it looks like she's controlling her rampage well enough that that's practically the only issue.
If I had to point out a problem from my perspective, it's something else――

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Uoraaaaaaaa！！」

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa……！？」
Just when I thought she'd closed in swinging her arm back, she whipped it upward in an instant. It was a brutal strike like an uppercut to the gut.
I barely dodged with a backstep, yet the sheer power—enough to feel sharp wind pressure right at the tip of my nose—sent a chill down my spine at the thought of taking a direct hit.
――Yet the very next moment, I felt heavy pressure overhead instead.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Shatteeeer！！」
Her blade came swinging down like a guillotine and slammed into the floor.
If this had been ordinary ground, it felt powerful enough that it might have actually shattered a bit.
Taking that on top of the strike just now would knock most people out cold. However――

name: Iori
message: 「……Now that I think about it, even when we first met, you left your back wide open just like this」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ngh！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hinyaaaaaaa！？」
Faster than Setsugekka could notice I'd slipped behind her and turn around. I drove my blade straight into her back.

name: Yorishiro-kun
message: 「Barrier Jacket has fallen below safe levels. Please end the combat simulation」
Just as Setsugekka collapsed face-down, an announcement rang out, ending the battle.
Hearing it, Setsugekka waited a moment before pushing herself up.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Owww...」

name: Iori
message: 「Good work, Setsugekka. Are you alright？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sensei, you went way too hard on me...」

name: Iori
message: 「What are you talking about? I haven't even come close to going all out yet.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Even though I was giving it pretty much everything I had...？！」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, I can't afford to lose to you just yet.」

name: Iori
message: 「Anyway—you've got your berserk state under control pretty well after all, haven't you？」

name: Iori
message: "Breaking their stance low and following up high isn't bad. A reverse grip hides your blade's position for a nice surprise attack—flashy and well-suited for the pros."

name: Iori
message: 「The downside is that by nature, your movements are easy to read, and you can't follow up once it's dodged. That's the part you'll need to figure out.」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, there are still a few rough spots, but you weren't letting the berserk state control you―I think you fought well. That's not really your weak point anymore, so―hey, Setsugekka？」
While I was rattling on, Setsugekka was keeping her mouth clamped shut for some reason. On top of that, as if she were dissatisfied with something, she seemed restless—

name: Iori
message: 「What's wrong？ Are you that frustrated about losing？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「N-No, that's not it！ It's just, I really don't think I have my berserk state under control after all...」

name: Iori
message: 「From where I'm standing, it's more than enough—」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I can't stop my body from aching！」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh？！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You know about it too, don't you, Sensei？！ When I go berserk, my, uh, s-sex drive, or whatever... it gets all hot deep inside my body！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「The more I fight, the hornier I get, and even though we're in the middle of special training, it's all I can think about, and Sensei's, um... a-anyway, it's no good！」

name: Iori
message: 「C-Calm down, Setsugekka！ For now, you probably shouldn't say that kind of thing out loud...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But my body just won't stop aching！ So even right now, my eyes keep drifting to your...！」

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka？！」
Feeling that gaze, I instinctively pulled half a step back.
Instead, Setsugekka began letting her eyes crawl all over my body as if licking me...

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I could even see every single drop of your flying sweat...！ If I'd managed to catch you there, if I'd managed to take you down...！ I really would've wrecked you in all sorts of ways, Sensei...！」

name: Iori
message: 「S-Setsugekka, just calm down...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh, uuuuugh...！ I-I'm going home for todayyyyyy！ Because I feel like I'm about to jump you right here and now, Senseiiiiii！」
Shouting that, Setsugekka bolted away.
She vanished from sight in an instant... though I thought I could still hear an alarming voice echoing from afar, shouting, 'I'm gonna jump you, Senseiiiiii！'...

name: Iori
message: 「...That definitely is a problem we need to work on.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「HraaAAAAH！」

name: Iori
message: 「Your sword strokes themselves are as sharp as ever, though！」
—Even after what happened, I continued having Sensei give me special training.
In fact, precisely because that happened, I needed the special training！ Sensei understood that too, and went along with me.
If he's going to go along with me, I'd rather he go out with me as lovers—no, never mind that for now.
Anyway, day after day, I fought Sensei in my berserk state.
While doing so, I tried somehow to hold back the lust surging up inside me.
Yet strangely enough... the more we did it, the stronger my runaway lust seemed to become.
So I thought desperately about the reason why.
Morning, noon, and night. And of course, during special training too.
While fighting Sensei, while looking at Sensei's body, while fantasizing about doing all sorts of things with Sensei—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wait—could it be...！！」

name: Iori
message: 「...Setsugekka？」
The sight of Sensei facing off against me.
The sight of my wonderful Sensei standing there so poised and dignified, barely even breathing hard after all our clashing...
As I stared intently at him—from top to bottom, and right in the middle too—it suddenly hit me.

name: Setsugekka
message: （Wait, isn't this less because of going berserk... and more because of Sensei！？）

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Today, please do the special training all by yourself, Iori-sensei！」

name: Iori
message: 「...Excuse me？」
When I asked him that the moment I arrived for training, Sensei blinked in wide-eyed bewilderment. ...Well, that's only natural.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I can't tell you why, but this is super important！ For now, please don't say anything and just train by yourself！ I'll be staring intently at you from the side！」

name: Iori
message: 「This special training is supposed to be for you, Setsugekka...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I think this will also be special training for me！」
I won't tell him the reason yet. Because it's kind of embarrassing.
I just pushed through on sheer momentum, and since Sensei is kind as always, he gave in and nodded for now.

name: Iori
message: 「Well... for starters, is my usual solo training routine okay？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'll leave the entire routine up to you！ Ah, though something a little intense might be good.」

name: Iori
message: 「I don't get it at all, but... alright. Then I'm starting.」
Saying that, Sensei began his solo training for me.
Starting with thorough stretches, then basic stamina training, practice swings... and perhaps because I asked for something intense, he even showed me striking practice using Yorishiro-kun.

name: Iori
message: 「Hah！ Sei！」
Far from his full strength, I'm sure, yet sharp and fierce strikes.
His expression is gallant, bold, and manly... his lean fighter's body, pumped up from the basic training, accentuated all the more...
Every single bead of sweat seeping out or flying off him looks like it's sparkling. If he looks like this even through his clothes, then what if he stripped them off... and then I would...！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haa, haa... Iori... Sensei...！」
My legs fidget on their own, and my hand almost moves down there.
Barely managing to hold myself back—I became certain.
This pounding in my chest, this ache, this craving... it really is because of Sensei！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I can't take it... Just looking at you, Iori-sensei... makes me feel so horny！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...And so, that's the situation.」

name: Iori
message: 「...I get the gist of it, at least.」
Having gained certainty, I revealed everything to Sensei.
Looking both troubled and shy, Sensei averted his gaze slightly with a red face. ...Just like me.

name: Iori
message: 「In short... looking at me puts you in that kind of mood, and then going berserk heightens it even further until you can't stop yourself, huh」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I think that's how it works！」

name: Iori
message: 「I see... Well, uh... I guess I shouldn't dig too deeply into the part about looking at me putting you in that mood, right?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Though things were already pretty awful back when we first met...」
To think he caught me right in the middle of relieving my out-of-control lust, and while I was screaming Iori-sensei's name, no less...

name: Iori
message: 「W-Well... either way, the fact remains that you need to control yourself while in a berserk state.」

name: Iori
message: 「If that's the case, from now on let's do special training with that in mind！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Is there really any special training that takes something like this into account？」

name: Iori
message: 「At least, I've never seen or heard of anything like it in my life so far. Still, it's not like it's unimaginable, right? ...Probably.」

name: Iori
message: 「And more than anything, it's for Setsugekka's sake.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hwaaaaaaah...... I'm so happy, Sensei！ It's almost like you're my personal trainer, or more like my lover！」

name: Iori
message: 「P-Please don't lose sight of the teacher-and-student part, at least......」

name: Iori
message: 「So anyway, let's do this right here today！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「T-This is...... the outdoor training ground！」

name: Iori
message: 「That's right！ Since it's outdoors, people might see us.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「People, seeing us...... That means......！」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah—even if you get aroused here, there are other people around, so you'll have to hold it back！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「W-What strict special training...... Thank you very much！！」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, thanks for getting into the mood so nicely. Then with this momentum, let's jump right into the training.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes！ ......Wait, people are actually going to see us, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「There aren't many people around right now, so the risk is low. Even so, there should still be a chance someone actually sees.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Then I really have to do my best to hold it back, don't I！」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course！ That's precisely why it makes for good training！」

name: Iori
message: 「So anyway, here we go！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Y-Yes, I'll do my best！ So I'm not seen...... so nobody else ever sees me looking like that......！！」
--And so, after sparring with Setsugekka in her out-of-control state for a while.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, your movements are somehow getting a bit better little by little. Even though you were stiff as a board when we started this training.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「......Ufufu, uhehe...... Um, Sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「W-What's wrong？ Did the effects of the training start showing after all？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well...... isn't everything just kind of fine as it is？」

name: Iori
message: 「What do you mean！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If we get seen, we get seen—I feel like just letting go completely is an option, too.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You know, like creating a fait accompli？ Like, maybe some liberating open-air play wouldn't be so bad？」

name: Iori
message: 「Retreat, retreaaaat！ We're calling off this special training！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Aww, no waaay！」
Dragging along Setsugekka, who somehow looked reluctant to leave, we hurried away from the scene.
Even after that, I tried one method after another, searching for a way to overcome Setsugekka's weakness （？）.

However, given the nature of this problem, Setsugekka always had to engage in combat. On top of that, she'd be in a berserk state and unable to hold back, so her body wouldn't hold up if she did that kind of special training day after day.
—With that concern in mind, I instructed her to take a few days off.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh？！ This much is totally fine for me！」

name: Iori
message: 「It's too late to rest once you're no longer fine. By resting while you're still thinking 'I'm fine,' you can stay fine for good.」

name: Iori
message: 「Besides, special training isn't something you should just do nonstop. When you do strength training, for example, you always schedule rest days for recovery. Otherwise, you'll actually end up losing muscle.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But I feel like if I don't do it every day, I'll lose my feel for it...」

name: Iori
message: 「You should still keep up with light exercise to review and check your form. You're just taking a break from full-scale special training.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Mmm... All right. If you insist that much, Sensei, I'll take tomorrow off！」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, please do. Get plenty of rest and recover, then we'll give the special training our all again.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes！ Well then, Sensei, thank you again for today.」
Flashing a cheerful smile, Setsugekka headed home.

name: Iori
message: 「Still... days off, huh.」
Even though I was the one who suggested it, I paused to think.
Special training was on break for the next few days—meaning I had the time off as well.

name: Iori
message: 「...What am I supposed to do with myself?」
At a complete loss over the loneliness of losing my daily routine, I sank into thought for a while.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sensei, let's go out together tomorrow！」
The next day—
Setsugekka had stopped by despite there being no special training, and she suddenly came out with that.

name: Iori
message: 「Go out？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「To put it flatly, it's a date！」

name: Iori
message: 「And to put it bumpily？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「A super fun outing！」

name: Iori
message: 「I feel like both of those are pretty flat, though.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That aside！ Anyway, won't you go out with me？」

name: Iori
message: 「But Setsugekka, we finally took a day off from special training... Are you sure？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Of course！ Besides, this isn't special training！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I mean, it's great having a day off and all, it's just... I didn't know what to do with myself during the break...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「When I thought about what I wanted to do, the very first thing that came to mind was, 'I want to be with Sensei！'」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But since we're taking a break from special training, we're going on a date instead！」

name: Iori
message: 「So that's it.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Besides, going out with someone you love is the best way to recharge！」

name: Iori
message: 「Good point—you might actually be right about that.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So, let's go out！」

name: Iori
message: 「...Alright, got it！ Tomorrow, let's go all out and have a blast together！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yay！ I finally get to go on a date with Sensei！」
Setsugekka bounces around, boing, boing, bursting with excitement. Watching her like that puts me in a great mood, too.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well then, let's decide on the meeting time and all that later！ I'll message you！」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah. I'll be waiting.」
Waving her hand wildly back and forth, Setsugekka bounces off on her way back.
Watching her go—

name: Iori
message: 「Alright—time to get tomorrow's work done today！」
With a spring in my step too, I eagerly headed off to work.
And then, on the day of our date—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Arrived thirty minutes early！ Hehehe, I was so excited I got here early... Surely I'm the first one here！」
I slowly stepped out right in front of Setsugekka as she was saying that！

name: Iori
message: 「Heh heh heh... How naive, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「S-Sensei？！ Don't tell me you got here even earlier than me...！」

name: Iori
message: 「That's right！ I got here forty minutes early！ Because I was way too excited！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I lost by ten minutes...！ Gah, I'd expect nothing less from Sensei...！」
Setsugekka, dropping to her knees in shock—
...Though I hurried to pull her back up and brush the dirt off her right away before the people around us started staring.

name: Iori
message: 「Either way, I’m glad you came. I actually had a girly moment getting here early and feeling a little anxious.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Of course I did, since I asked you out！ Besides, a date with you, Sensei—no matter what happens, I’m definitely going！」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, thanks. I was looking forward to it too.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「……By the way, Sensei？ We still have 30 minutes until the meetup, so what should we do with this time？」

name: Iori
message: 「True. 30 minutes, huh, that’s pretty long――」

name: Iori
message: 「……Wait a second. Since we’re both here already, shouldn’t we just start the date right now？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「T-True……！！ Then, then, let’s start dating right away！」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah！ Let’s do this date！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「By the way, what kind of things do you do on a date！？」

name: Iori
message: 「No clue！」

name: Iori
message: 「……For now, just walking together, maybe？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Let’s walk！」
And just like that, we ended up walking！
Walking.
Walking no matter what.
Walking for all we’re worth.
Walking side by side with Setsugekka with nowhere in particular to go, the two of us just walked.
Even though I’d casually said OK to the date, I didn’t even know what to talk about during it, so we stayed mostly quiet with each other.
Every now and then, I could hear Setsugekka huffing and puffing with determination.
Glancing sideways, Setsugekka had a look on her face that was somehow smug, or rather brimming with motivation.
Meanwhile, even as I walked, I was thinking about what to do……
Thinking……

name: Iori
message: 「…………What else are we supposed to do now, I wonder.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I don’t know！」
Her answer’s full of energy, huh.
For now, walking even more――
……So we’ve walked even more.

name: Iori
message: 「…………Setsugekka, are you having fun？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I’m having so much fun！」

name: Iori
message: 「Then I guess it's fine！」
And so we start walking again！

name: Iori
message: 「......No, it's not fine！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eeh？！ Was my outfit not good...？！」

name: Iori
message: 「No, not that. Actually, your outfit's cute, it looks great on you. It brings out your cuteness even more, Setsugekka」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「R-Really？ Hehehe... You're gonna make me blush if you say that much...♪」

name: Iori
message: 「That's not what I meant！」

name: Iori
message: 「We're supposed to be on a date, yet all we've been doing this whole time is walking around in complete silence」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Was that no good？」

name: Iori
message: 「...No, it's not that it's bad or anything... I'm having fun just walking side by side with you too, Setsugekka」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Right?！ Just being together like this makes me feel all giddy inside... Mhehe」
Honestly, there's no doubt it's fun.
Even I was surprised by how much my spirits could soar just from walking together.
...However.

name: Iori
message: 「Still, since we're out here, don't you feel like trying to do something together？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Do something together, just the two of us？ ......W-Wait, do you mean something lewd？！」

name: Iori
message: 「Why？！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「N-No way！ Didn't you say before that doing it outdoors is a no-go?！ Even I get a little embarrassed about that, or rather, I'd like to wait until I have a bit more experience before trying stuff like that！」

name: Iori
message: 「Not that！ Something more like... normal fun stuff, you know」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Normal fun stuff...？」

name: Iori
message: 「Like, uh, you know... something...」

name: Iori
message: 「...Well, if I could think of something on the spot, I wouldn't be stuck like this」
My dating experience is so completely nonexistent that I can't come up with a single example.
Even when something does pop into my head, it's all training-like stuff—going for a run together, doing practice swings together, sparring together.

name: Iori
message: 「Can you think of anything, Setsugekka？ Like, the go-to fun activity for a date」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmm, let's see...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh！ Come to think of it, I think I saw a magazine feature on great leisure spots for dates！」

name: Iori
message: 「That's it！ What did it say？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I forgot！」

name: Iori
message: 「You forgot, huh」
Well, can't help it then.

name: Iori
message: 「Still, at this rate, it really looks like we're just going to keep walking the whole time. Rather than a date, it's turning into a fitness walk. Maybe we should just run... No, that'd just be straight-up training...」
As I was mulling it over—Setsugekka had another flash of inspiration.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I know！ How about we try asking Kei-chan？」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh？ Does Keisetsu know a lot about that kind of thing？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm not sure if she's an expert, but she's gotta know more than I do！」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, could you go ahead and ask her then？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Okay, got it！」
And so, we decided to ask Keisetsu for advice.
Setsugekka made the call, and the two of them talked for a bit...
Before long. Setsugekka hung up the phone and turned to me with a look that said she'd gotten something good.

name: Iori
message: 「Did you get any helpful ideas？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes！ According to Kei-chan, we should just enjoy something we both like, such as watching a movie or going to a sports game！」

name: Iori
message: 「Something we both like, huh」
Something Setsugekka and I have in common...

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Also, she said games or sports the two of us can do together are classics too！」

name: Iori
message: 「I see. Well, for starters... what kind of things do you like, Setsugekka？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I... like Jindou！ What about you, Sensei？」

name: Iori
message: 「I like Jindou too」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yay, same here！」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, yeah. Same here」
Sharing a cheerful laugh—
This time, an idea suddenly hits me！

name: Iori
message: 「I've got it！ Since we both like Jindou, how about we go watch a Jindou match？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, that sounds great！ I'd love to watch one with you, Sensei！」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, it's decided！ I'm pretty sure there's a place around here where we can watch a pro match. Let's go check it out！」
And so, we headed out to watch the match.

name: Iori
message: 「Man, that was a great match！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes！ Pro matches really are so intense！」
We couldn't quite watch it live, though. Thankfully, there was a place like a sports bar, so we still managed to catch the match there.
As expected, the atmosphere inside was electric, and we ended up getting completely carried away and cheering right along with everyone.
And even now, after leaving the bar, our excitement still refusing to die down...！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Especially that thing in that match—it was amazing, wasn't it?！ It was all like, 'kaboom！' And then like, 'bam-bam-bam！' Plus, I can't believe that person's thing turned out to be that kind of thing！」

name: Iori
message: 「I have zero idea what you're talking about, but I can definitely feel your excitement！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Uuugh...！ If only I could fight like that someday...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Alright！ Sensei, let's spar！」

name: Iori
message: 「What's gotten into you all of a sudden?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Watching the match made me want to fight too！」

name: Iori
message: 「Fair enough. It really was a heated enough match to make you feel that way. Even I was itching to get moving a bit.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Right?！ Then let's get right to it！ So without further ado, here I come...！」
Saying that, Setsugekka suddenly dropped into an unarmed fighting stance.

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa, wait, wait！ You obviously can't do that right in the middle of the street.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah... Sorry, I got a little ahead of myself... Ehehe.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Then let's head to the academy！ We can go all out there！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「For example, I bet I can even pull off that flashy move where that fighter from earlier was running all over the place！」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, gonna try recreating a pro fighter's moves？ Actually, that might turn out to be pretty good training in its own right.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That sounds great, really great！ Come on then, Sensei！ Let's hurry up and get there so we can start！」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, alright, I get it, so stop pulling me.」
With a thoroughly hyped-up Setsugekka pulling me by the hand, we hurried off toward the academy.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hyaaaaaaaaah！ Finishing move！ The secret ultimate technique that fighter used to end the match！ Plancha Tornillo Ultra Tiger Sasuke Special！」

name: Iori
message: 「Not so fast！ The secret ultimate technique used by the fighter who lost to that one！ Chaotic High-Speed Immovable Darkness Rock-Breaking Peerless Thousand-Armed Kannon！」
Our two techniques collided, somehow feeling like they triggered a massive explosion—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Gahaa！」

name: Yorishiro-kun
message: 「Barrier Jacket has fallen below safe levels. Please end the combat simulation」

name: Iori
message: 「...I win.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I lost！」
When I mimed sheathing a sword, Setsugekka sprang right up.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh... To think you'd get revenge for that match！」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, neither of us has anything to do with the actual fighters, though.」
The fighters from that match would probably never in their wildest dreams imagine a rematch being held in a place like this.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Even so, Sensei, you really are amazing. You only saw that technique once, and you've already mastered it.」

name: Iori
message: 「I haven't mastered it, though. If I actually wanted to make it my own, I'd need a lot more practice.」

name: Iori
message: 「Besides, if we're talking about that, you remembered a technique you only saw once pretty well yourself, Setsugekka. I was surprised.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hehehe...♪ I haven't mastered it at all either, of course, but it was flashy and left a strong impression.」

name: Iori
message: 「I really do think you've gotten a lot stronger, Setsugekka. It shows in things like this too.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「R-Really？ Nhehe... You're praising me so much today...♪」

name: Iori
message: 「That's because you have so many great qualities, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sensei won't stop killing me with praise...！」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha. Still, even if it was a bit different from usual, this wasn't bad in its own way.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I don't think I'll ever use that move from earlier again either, but I feel like I got a little hint for a new way of fighting！」

name: Iori
message: 「Then I'm glad. That was some good special training.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes！ Thanks to that, I can get a little stronger again！」
We exchanged words and shared a refreshing laugh—
Shared a laugh...

name: Iori
message: 「...Wait, wasn't this supposed to be a date? How did it turn into special training?！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Gasp! Now that you mention it!」

name: Iori
message: 「Could it be that for us, the ultimate form of a date is special training...」

name: Setsugekka
message: "I've been completely consumed by special training...!"

name: Setsugekka
message: "Oh, wait a second—if the ultimate form of a date is special training, then..."

name: Setsugekka
message: "Doesn't that mean we've actually been going on dates every single day?!"

name: Iori
message: "W-Well, technically...!!"

name: Iori
message: "...Wait, technically?"
It sounded like a shocking revelation for a second, until I thought about it and realized it wasn't.

name: Setsugekka
message: "Sensei, thank you so much for today!"
With our special training—no, our date—wrapped up, it was time to part ways.
Looking thoroughly fulfilled, Setsugekka gave me a polite bow.

name: Setsugekka
message: "Going on a date with you was truly fun, Sensei."

name: Iori
message: "I had a great time too. Thank you."

name: Setsugekka
message: "Next time, I'll study up even more on dates—leisure spots and things like that!"

name: Iori
message: "Then I'd better do my homework too so I don't lose. Like date plans that won't bore you, Setsugekka."

name: Setsugekka
message: "As long as I'm with you, Sensei, I could never be bored!"

name: Iori
message: "Haha, thanks."
We're talking as if a 'next time' is a given—well, it is a given, so I suppose that's fine.

name: Setsugekka
message: "Well then, Sensei, I'll take my leave for today! Good night!"

name: Iori
message: "Yeah, good night. See you tomorrow."
Waving enthusiastically, Setsugekka headed home with a light, skipping step.
Once she turned the corner, she even poked her head back out just to wave wildly one more time.
Seeing her off, I turned back toward my own place with a light step as well.
And when I arrived in front of my room—

name: Keisetsu
message: "Welcome back, Iori-san. Thank you for going out with Setsugekka today."
Keisetsu was standing right outside my door.

name: Iori
message: "Keisetsu? What's going on?"

name: Keisetsu
message: "I figured you'd be getting back soon, so I waited. There's something I'd like to discuss—do you have a moment?"

name: Iori
message: "...It's not about being a private trainer again, is it?"

name: Keisetsu
message: "Even I wouldn't be that tactless right now. Today it's just a little casual chat."
Saying that, Keisetsu held up a small bag—apparently a little gift she brought for me.

name: Iori
message: 「...If I let you in right now, won't it look like I got hooked by your gift？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「You're overthinking it. Just take it as a token of my everyday gratitude.」
Maybe my answer surprised her, because Keisetsu smiled as if amused.
Once I let her into the room, Keisetsu first asked if she could borrow the kitchen.
And just when I thought she might actually cook something, she came right back.
Only this time, she was holding a teacup in her hand.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Here you go. There's nothing strange in it, so you can relax.」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, I'm not worried to that extent.」
I took the cup and breathed in lightly, and a gentle aroma seeped into me.
It seemed she had brewed some herbal tea. So this was the true identity of the gift from earlier.

name: Iori
message: 「Huh... That smells nice.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「It's tea blended with matsuri-ka. I think it'll calm your mind.」

name: Iori
message: 「Matsuri-ka？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Maybe it's easier to understand if I call it jasmine. I've liked this scent since I was little.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Whenever I spend special time, I always remember this fragrance.」

name: Iori
message: 「So it's something important to you, Keisetsu.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, that's right.」
I took a sip of the jasmine tea.
Even though the season was already summer, this warmth spreading slowly, combined with the scent, seemed to loosen the tension in my body.

name: Iori
message: 「So... what is it you wanted to talk about？ You said it's like small talk, though.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Fufu. When it comes to what I talk to you about, there's nothing else besides Setsugekka, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「Fair enough. Though I doubt it's about being her personal trainer.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, what I want to ask today is a matter of feelings—in other words, about your relationship with Setsugekka.」

name: Iori
message: 「Relationship, you say...」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Even if the method had plenty of problems, Setsugekka still told you her feelings all the same.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「And you answered that you want her to wait a little longer for now.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「But in truth, you already have your answer from the start, don't you？」

name: Iori
message: 「Ugh... That's...」
It looks like she's seen right through me.
...Well, I suppose it'd be stranger if she hadn't.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Just as I thought. Why don't you tell her right away？」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, even if you ask me that... Being teacher and student makes things complicated in all sorts of ways, doesn't it?」

name: Iori
message: 「That's why I told Setsugekka to wait a little longer for now, too.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Merely a matter of your positions？ That seems quite trivial to me.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Your real occupation is a member of the Tenju Special Forces, not a teacher. Is there any issue with a member and an academy student having a romance？」

name: Iori
message: 「W-Well, when you put it like that...」
In truth, part of me already felt like it would be fine.
And above all, I wanted to tell Setsugekka how I felt directly as soon as possible.
There were plenty of things I had to hold back because we weren't lovers, and that was frustrating in its own right.
Setsugekka seemed to have trouble keeping herself in check when she went into a runaway state, though truthfully, I wasn't much different.
Having to constantly rein in the full force of our feelings around each other wasn't just a burden on me—it was taking a toll on Setsugekka too, and it pained me to put her through that.

name: Iori
message: （Getting through the hard times together... If holding back already puts us in that position, wouldn't things be no different even if I just told her how I feel...？）
As I agonized over it—Keisetsu suddenly let out a small laugh.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「If you're agonizing over it, that means you're thinking seriously about Setsugekka, doesn't it？」

name: Iori
message: 「...Yeah, that's right.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Then by all means, please take care of Setsugekka. That is her wish, and it is mine as well.」

name: Iori
message: 「You wish for that too, Keisetsu？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Though she lost at the Martial Festival, Setsugekka fought admirably. Thanks to that, the Kazamine family's standing in the Sword-Bearing Self-Defense Association has improved greatly.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That is unmistakably your achievement.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「If someone like you will continue to guide Setsugekka permanently from now on, that is immensely reassuring to me as well.」

name: Iori
message: 「P-Permanently？！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Oh my, don't tell me you intend to discard Setsugekka once you grow tired of her？ If that's the case, that changes things a little.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, no, I have absolutely no intention of doing that！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「In other words, I can take it that you're entering this relationship with permanence in mind, correct？」

name: Iori
message: 「Y-Yes...」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Hehe, I'm so glad. That you're such an earnest man.」
Damn it... That's exactly right, but somehow it just doesn't sit well with me...！

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Then please continue to guide Setsugekka from here on out. In Jindou, in her daily life, and as her partner, too.」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course, that’s my intention. I am a teacher, and—well... regardless, that is my intention！」
I nearly said 'lover,' then hurriedly muddled my words.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「However, once you start dating, it will require a certain amount of tact.」

name: Iori
message: 「Is that... because we’re teacher and student, after all？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That’s part of it, but it’s mainly a matter of your own mindset.」

name: Iori
message: 「Mindset... what do you mean by that？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Within the Sword-Bearing Self-Defense Association, the wind is still blowing quite hard against the Kazamine family.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「If you become involved with Setsugekka, you will be caught up in that headwind as well. Do you have the resolve for that？」

name: Iori
message: 「Is that all? Is that what this is about?」

name: Iori
message: 「I’ve been treated like a pariah from the start. It won’t be much different from how things are now.」
The Muragaki Family has always been the black sheep within the Sword-Bearing Self-Defense Association.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I see... you’re strong, aren’t you.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka is very lucky. I wish I could have met someone like you myself.」

name: Iori
message: 「Aren’t we meeting right now?」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I meant, meeting sooner.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「If that had happened, I wouldn’t have handed you over to Setsugekka.」

name: Iori
message: 「You sure say some dangerous things.」
In any case, it was a relief to know that I had Keisetsu's backing.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That said, rather than the distant future, we need to consider the immediate problem. Specifically, what to do about Setsugekka’s career path.」

name: Iori
message: 「Doesn't Setsugekka want to join the Pro League？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, but with the issue regarding the secret arts, it’s a difficult situation.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see, you're right...」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「But if it’s what Setsugekka desires, I intend to do what I can before she graduates.」

name: Iori
message: 「You mean you’re going to look for a way for her to go pro?」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Because that is both my duty... and my wish. I want to make Setsugekka's hopes and feelings come true.」

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka's lucky, having an older sister like you.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Fufu, I hope she feels that way. I still have a long way to go, though. I'll keep striving.」

name: Iori

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Then while you're showering, I'll go fetch them from your room, Sensei！」

name: Iori
message: 「What kind of logic is that？！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「And then if we just bring all of your personal belongings here too, and you come home here every day...！」

name: Iori
message: 「Isn't that just living together...？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I just thought maybe your home could just be right here from now on, Sensei！」

name: Iori
message: 「No, that would obviously be a problem. This is a dorm, after all.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmm... Now that you mention it, you're right. That does sound a bit iffy.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「After all, if we're going to live together, I'd really want a house of our own eventually！」

name: Iori
message: 「When did this turn completely into moving in together—or rather, assuming we're getting married？！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh？ Sensei, don't tell me... you aren't going to marry me...？！」

name: Iori
message: 「No, I'm definitely marrying you. In fact, as long as you don't mind, Setsugekka, right after you graduate！」
That's a certainty.
At my firm declaration, Setsugekka gave a happy little bounce on the bed.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yay！ Honestly, I feel like even right now would be fine with me, though I guess that really would be a little too soon, right?」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah. It'll fly by in no time, though. Since it's until you graduate, that's two and a half years... no, three and a half years！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Why are you assuming I'm going to repeat a year？！」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, just kidding.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Jeez, honestly... If I get held back, it's all your fault, Sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「Don't worry. I won't let that happen. That's why I'm going to whip you into shape！」
When I pointed at her decisively, Setsugekka nodded back with a smile.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes! I'll do my best to keep up with you! Forever and ever!」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah. Forever—for the rest of our lives.」
Laughing together like that, we promised each other a happy future.
